items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: We've been friends ever since the operations.

ctx.x: What hospital did you go to New Orleans, to Turo? That's where you are. You remember Turo Infirmary? Yeah. That's where every night when you called your number I said Turo Infirmary. But I didn't know that was the hospital you see here. See, I didn't know you knew what I was talking about. I said sure. Are you calling you all wrong?

There's no answer. Well, Archie was president of the Cancer Society. Just name it. He was the head of it. He was a fabulous man. Wonderful man too. We've been friends ever since the operations. Where are you now? 39.
